title: it494-threadatlas-oz-key
subtitle: Baum's Oz characters as an identity key for ThreadAtlas (CC BY-SA 4.0)
description: One entry per character L. Frank Baum created, from Wikipedia's 'List of Oz characters (created by Baum)' (revision 1374825486, CC BY-SA 4.0), with the names the page gives it and 53 hand-added aliases, counted. Scores a ThreadAtlas store's parents over the three Oz books: cross-document pairs of matched children united or split, wrong joins, parents per character. README.md in the dataset says how.
